verdict.rationale: Ollama is a model runtime with a local server and a cloud API, so a sandbox or test-environment capability is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents no sandbox, test mode or isolated environment separate from production data. Local execution and data privacy ("Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine") are an adjacent property, not a sandbox feature, and the docs' interactive API playground is disabled.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
